title: Trino shadow build fails before writing: SET SESSION privileged property
answers: Trino shadow model build fails before creating the table
Managed warehouse materialization fails with permission error on session property
Trino connection user cannot set query_max_run_time
Alias refresh fails on SET SESSION in Trino
body:
Symptom: Trino shadow model builds (and alias refreshes) fail before any table is written because the connection user cannot change system session properties.
Root cause: products/managed_warehouse/backend/trino_materialization.py:execute_trino_shadow_materialization and products/managed_warehouse/backend/trino_model_aliases.py:reconcile_trino_model_aliases issued `SET SESSION query_max_run_time = ...` as the first statement.
Fix pattern: Remove server-side session-property statements and rely on client-enforced deadlines plus cancellation through the attached cursor (control.attach(cursor) / checkpoint()).
Constraints: Applies to any Trino path in managed_warehouse using a restricted connection user; do not reintroduce privileged SET SESSION calls. Note fetchall side_effect lists in tests must match the exact statement sequence, so removing or adding a statement shifts them.
applies: products/managed_warehouse Trino execution paths (shadow materialization, model alias reconcile)

search: Trino shadow materializations and alias refreshes fail before writing tables because execute_trino_shadow_materialization and reconcile_trino_model_aliases issued `SET SESSION query_max_run_time = ...` as the first statement, which restricted connection users cannot execute. Fix: remove privileged SET SESSION calls and rely on client-enforced deadlines with cursor cancellation via control.attach(cursor) and checkpoint() in products/managed_warehouse/backend/trino_model_aliases.py. Do not reintroduce privileged SET SESSION statements; applies to any managed_warehouse Trino path using restricted connection users. Removing statements shifts fetchall.side_effect lists in tests, so all test indexes must be updated.
